sentences.en: Well, I bake bread, listen to music, or read comic books.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会烤面包、听音乐或读漫画书。

sentences.en: No one bakes a finer apple pie than Emily.
sentences.zh: 没有人能像艾米丽那样做出更美味的苹果派。

sentences.en: The fish is baked slowly till browned over a not-too-close fire.
sentences.zh: 这条鱼在不太近的火上慢慢烘烤至金黄色。
